## Code review: network picker search (WA-3477)

**Verdict: fix one bug before you open the PR.** The rest are small.

This was a condensed run of the review, not the full nine-pass pipeline. I reviewed every changed file myself instead of starting one agent per area. Only the top finding went through the validator and refuter agents; the other six were checked by me alone. Because of that there is **no numeric score**, and the ratings on the unadjudicated findings are my own call.

**Scope:** 10 files, +1052 −18. The diff is `61b0447...HEAD`, three-dot, so it is measured from the merge-base `9060a35` to `cec2643`. The working tree only has two untracked paths outside this diff, and they were ignored.

**Repo:** Safe{Wallet} web (Next.js, TypeScript), Jest with Testing Library, base-ui primitives. The rules I checked against come from the root and `apps/web` `AGENTS.md` (no `any`, one-line comments only, sentence case, and the `no-restricted-syntax` escape rule).

**Adjudicated 1 of 7:** the top finding came back confirmed and standing. Nothing was ruled out or merged with another finding.

### Must fix before opening

**F1 · P2 · Bug: picking a row in the space-bar chain picker keeps the old search**
`apps/web/src/features/spaces/components/SafeSelectorDropdown/components/ChainSelectorBlock.tsx:113` (also `:46` and `:53`)
- **What:** The search only clears inside `handleOpenChange`. Clicking a deployed-chain row (`:113`) or an add-network row (`handleAddNetworkClick`, `:46`) closes the menu with a direct `setOpen(false)`. Because `open` is controlled, base-ui just copies the prop into its store and never calls `onOpenChange`. That is in `MenuRoot.js:104` and `ReactStore.js:102-113`, so `setSearch('')` never runs.
- **Why it matters:** `SpaceChainSelector` keeps this block mounted in the safe bar. Switching chains is only a query update, and the add-network dialog is rendered alongside it. So after typing "poly" and picking Polygon, the next time you open the picker it is still filtered. That is the exact case the comment on `:53` says it handles.
- **Why tests pass:** the reopen test (`__tests__/ChainSelectorBlock.test.tsx:248`) only toggles through the mocked `onOpenChange`.
- **Fix:** send both close paths through one helper that resets the search, e.g. `close = () => { setOpen(false); setSearch('') }`. Then add a test: type, click a row, reopen, and expect an empty field and all three chains.
- **Adjudication:** the validator confirmed it and the refuter could not defeat it. Both traced base-ui 1.2.0's source, and the refuter also confirmed that the chain switch does not remount the component.

### Worth fixing or a ticket (P3)

| # | Location | Finding |
|---|---|---|
| F2 | `apps/web/src/components/common/NetworkSelector/index.tsx:439` (and `:427`) | In the header picker, any search hides "Show all networks" entirely (`!query && …UndeployedNetworks`). A network you could add then shows "No networks match your search", which isn't true. The space-bar picker does search its "All networks" section, so the two pickers behave differently. If this is deliberate (see commit `5e6aa5415`), change the empty copy, e.g. to name deployed networks only. |
| F3 | `.../components/AllNetworksSection.tsx:58` | When `unavailableReason` is set, the component returns the notice without `nothingToShow`. A search that matches nothing above then shows only "Adding another network is not possible…" and no "No networks match your search" line. The feature-disabled branch (`:56`) and the empty branch (`:98`) both show it. |
| F4 | `apps/web/src/components/ui/search-input.tsx:38` | The clear button disappears as soon as you click it (`showClear` goes false), and focus is not moved back to the input. Focus falls to `<body>`, so you have to click the field again to keep typing. Moving focus back to the input from inside `SearchInput` would fix it. I have not checked what base-ui does with focus in this case. |
| F5 | `NetworkSelector/index.tsx:306`, `ChainSelectorBlock.tsx:42`, `AllNetworksSection.tsx:101` | The same name match (`chainName.toLowerCase().includes(query)`) is written three times. The "No networks match your search" text appears twice (`index.tsx:433`, `AllNetworksSection.tsx:52`), and the rule that lets Escape through is written twice (`index.tsx:364`, `ChainSelectorBlock.tsx:59`). One small shared helper and a shared text constant would keep the two pickers from drifting apart, which F2 and F3 already show happening. |
| F6 | `.../__tests__/ChainSelectorBlock.test.tsx:248` | Nothing tests reopening after a row click or an add-network click, which is why F1 got through. The header picker has the same gap, although there base-ui item selection does go through `onOpenChange`. |
| F7 | `NetworkSelector/index.tsx:404-406`, `ChainSelectorBlock.tsx:93-96` | The same "concentric radius" `eslint-disable-next-line no-restricted-syntax` appears twice, and each time a JSX comment above it says the same thing again. `apps/web/AGENTS.md:24-26` says a repeated escape should become a variant rather than another disable, and the root `AGENTS.md` asks for at most one comment line. At least drop the duplicate JSX comments. |

### Not covered
- There was no separate security, performance or regression agent pass. Nothing in the diff looks exposed: the search is local UI state over short chain lists. `SearchInput`'s new `onClear` prop is optional, so existing callers are unchanged.
- I didn't check whether stopping every key except Escape in `NetworkSelector` (`index.tsx:364`) also breaks base-ui's Tab or Home/End handling in the Select.
- I didn't run the app, run the tests, or check the Storybook stories visually.
- Only F1 was adjudicated; F2–F7 are unadjudicated.
- `.git/safe-code-review/last-run.tsv` was not written because this run was read-only, so the next run has no earlier run to compare against.
- There were no tidy-up proposals, so there is nothing to choose between fixing, ticketing or skipping.
